# Mistral Large 4 (October 29 weights)

Mistral · released 2026-10

Improved October 29 open-weight release following three weeks of additional reinforcement learning, distinct from the October 6 public preview. Preview benchmark results are not assigned to this checkpoint. No verified eligible exact-release benchmark imported yet; unknown API price omitted. Custom ecosystem licence allows commercial/noncommercial use subject to conditions; Model-as-a-Service businesses require a separate commercial licence. Native text/image inputs, reasoning high by default; NVFP4 is a separate artifact and its quality is not assumed identical.

[Model and usage documentation](https://huggingface.co/mistralai/Mistral-Large-4-1T-A52B)

No reviewed benchmark results yet. This catalogue entry has no score or rank.

## How to run it

### Through an API

api (Mistral AI) · price unknown · [docs.mistral.ai](https://docs.mistral.ai/models/mistral-large-4-0)

### Other ways to run it

1. Run it as published (BF16, needs ~2000 GB, NVIDIA only, from [huggingface.co/mistralai](https://huggingface.co/mistralai/Mistral-Large-4-1T-A52B/blob/f12dabdc0c1e99e7f7924461a6f308859b05af4d/README.md))
   
   ```sh
   docker run --runtime nvidia --gpus all -v ~/.cache/huggingface:/root/.cache/huggingface -p 8000:8000 --ipc=host vllm/vllm-openai:mistral-large-4 --model mistralai/Mistral-Large-4-1T-A52B --tensor-parallel-size 8 --tool-call-parser mistral --reasoning-parser mistral --enable-auto-tool-choice --gpu-memory-utilization 0.85
   ```

Official weights and documentation: [huggingface.co/mistralai](https://huggingface.co/mistralai/Mistral-Large-4-1T-A52B)
